section_1_ui_accessibility_wcag_aa.title: UI Accessibility & WCAG AA Compliance
research_questions: What does WCAG AA compliance mean for links and text colors?
What tools can validate contrast ratios automatically?
How to test with color blindness simulators?

findings.topic: WCAG AA Standards for Color Contrast
findings.finding: WCAG AA requires minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (18pt+)
findings.action: All text elements must meet 4.5:1 contrast

findings.finding: Links must be distinguishable from surrounding text both by color AND another indicator (underline, icon, etc). Cannot rely on color alone.
Contrast ratios must be maintained in BOTH light and dark themes. Different background colors change contrast calculations.
findings.action: Test colors in both themes before approval

findings.finding: Multiple free tools available: axe DevTools (automated), WebAIM contrast checker (manual), Lighthouse (Chromium)
findings.recommendation: Use axe DevTools during development, WebAIM for manual verification, Lighthouse before submission

findings.finding: Coblis simulator (online tool) allows testing color perception for deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia
findings.applicability: S1.2 (complex color scheme with message types)
findings.testing_protocol: Test conversation detail view in all 3 color blindness types

section_2_drag_drop_libraries.title: Drag & Drop Implementation Patterns & Libraries
research_questions: What libraries are available in Vue 3 ecosystem?
Is vuedraggable available in this project?
What are performance considerations for 100+ cards?
How to handle touch events for mobile?

findings.description: Vue wrapper around SortableJS - handles drag/drop with minimal code
findings.code_example: Simple v-model binding, handles state automatically
findings.browser_support: All modern browsers, mobile touch support
findings.recommendation: CHECK if installed in package.json first. If yes, USE IT. If no, use native API.

findings.description: Standard browser API for drag operations
findings.browser_support: All modern browsers, limited mobile support
cons: Mobile support requires separate touch event handlers
Firefox has different behavior than Chrome

implementation_pattern.on_mousedown: Start drag after 200ms delay, create ghost image
implementation_pattern.on_mousemove: Update drag overlay position, check drop targets
implementation_pattern.on_drop: Validate target, post to backend, animate reallocation
edge_cases: Drag over non-drop zones → visual feedback
Multiple cards → ensure single card selected

findings.recommendation: FALLBACK ONLY - use vuedraggable if available

findings.description: Techniques for smooth drag with 100+ cards

patterns.why: Render only visible cards, not all 100+
Dragover fires 100s of times/sec, reflows DOM excessively
Prevent re-rendering of drag handlers on every render
Updating DOM position during drag causes reflows
patterns.code: Use CSS transforms (will-change) instead of position

findings.testing: Lighthouse performance audit, browser DevTools FPS counter

findings.description: Handling drag on mobile and tablet
challenges: Touch API different from mouse events
No native drag API for touch

implementation.code_pattern: Add touch event listeners paralleling mouse listeners

libraries: Hammer.js (gesture library) - can help with long press detection
Native touch events (simpler but more code)
findings.testing: Real device testing (iPhone/Android), Chrome mobile emulation

findings.finding: Firefox drag API behaves differently than Chrome: drag image handling, drop zone detection, animation timing
findings.recommendation: Test explicitly in Firefox DevTools, don't just assume Chrome behavior applies

section_3_contact_deduplication.title: Contact Deduplication Patterns & Data Safety
research_questions: What are proven patterns for contact merging?
How do successful platforms (Slack, Gmail) handle this?

findings.description: Find contacts matching on email + phone
findings.implementation: SQL query with both email AND phone matching
findings.data_safety: SAFE - only merges if both match
findings.recommendation: Phase 1: Implement this first, safe baseline

findings.description: Levenshtein distance on name, phone normalization
findings.data_safety: RISKY - need audit trail, soft deletes, careful testing
findings.recommendation: Phase 2: After exact match working, add fuzzy with threshold 0.95+

findings.topic: Platform Examples: How Slack/Gmail Handle It

slack.approach: Email-based deduplication, manual merge on workspace

gmail.approach: Automatic exact match on email, manual merge for contacts
gmail.note: User can unmerge if false positive

salesforce.approach: Multiple matching algorithms, human review for fuzzy matches
salesforce.data_safety: Zero data loss - logs everything, reversible

findings.common_pattern: Exact match (automatic) + Fuzzy match (manual review or high threshold) + Full audit trail

findings.topic: Data Safety: Soft Deletes vs Hard Deletes
findings.finding: NEVER hard-delete merged contacts - use soft deletes

soft_delete.approach: Mark as merged but keep record

risks: Data loss if merge was mistake

findings.implementation: Follow soft-delete pattern exactly as in S4.1 story

findings.finding: If A merges to B, B merges to C, queries must follow chain
findings.problem: SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE id=A → merged_to_id=B, but B also merged!
findings.solution: Follow merged_to_id chain: A → B → C (final contact)

code_pattern.caching: Cache result to avoid N queries

findings.finding: Large-scale deduplication should run as background job
why: Can process 10K+ contacts without blocking requests
Can batch process to avoid memory overflow

implementation.pattern: Iterate in batches (e.g., 100 at a time)
implementation.batching: Find duplicates in batch, merge, commit, move to next
implementation.logging: Log each merge decision for audit

findings.finding: Deduplication is critical path - needs comprehensive testing
test_cases: Merging contacts with different channel conversations
Ensure NO data loss (all messages preserved)
Staging environment dry-run with production data snapshot
findings.recommendation: Write tests BEFORE implementation, use TDD approach
